# Element styles

How those elements are drawn. One style object, shared. Created with `kind` **`elementstyle`**.

| Type | Class |
|---|---|
| [`"balloon"`](#spec-balloon) | `BalloonPopupStyleBuilder` |
| [`"line"`](#spec-line) | `LineStyleBuilder` |
| [`"marker"`](#spec-marker) | `MarkerStyleBuilder` |
| [`"point"`](#spec-point) | `PointStyleBuilder` |
| [`"polygon"`](#spec-polygon) | `PolygonStyleBuilder` |
| [`"text"`](#spec-text) | `TextStyleBuilder` |
